verdict.rationale: Kong's evidence covers Vault-based secret storage that can pull from environment variables (kong-docs-47, kong-docs-48) and decK for APIOps automation, but there is no documentation of an 'environment variable set' mechanism for switching requests between dev/staging/prod environments as a developer-facing feature. Missing for 10: explicit environment/workspace switching feature, environment variable sets tied to requests, and any hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
